layman_headline: Market fear is high and no swing trade setup is clean enough to justify risking capital right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood (27/100 on the Fear & Greed Index) and has been trending that way all week. Bitcoin is down 2.5% over seven days and most altcoins are bleeding harder. While a couple of coins show interesting signals — like BONK being oversold or ADA surging 15% in a week — the overall environment is hostile to altcoins with Bitcoin dominance at 56.3% and no clear catalyst to reverse the downtrend. The safest move is to wait for a better setup.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is fearful and trending down. Better buying opportunities are likely coming within days if the selling continues, or a clear reversal signal will emerge. Don't chase anything right now.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 27 is close to the 25 threshold where Rule #3 says the outlook is genuinely ambiguous and holding is safest. The worsening trend (week avg 27.9, still declining) suggests we haven't found a floor. BTC dominance at 56.3% is actively punishing altcoins. Of the candidates: KAITO RSI at 87 is a strong sell signal per our most reliable indicator (RSI 71% win rate); BONK's oversold RSI is promising but contradicted by bearish chart structure and -26.5% 5-day momentum; LDO's -17% weekly drop with neutral RSI (52) suggests it hasn't bottomed; FET is bearish on chart with bearish engulfing. No candidate offers a high-conviction setup with clear risk/reward above 2x and confirming signals across multiple dimensions.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed could deteriorate below 25, triggering further selling and making any current entry premature
The Coldcard exploit spreading to 4,500 addresses could worsen sentiment and trigger broader risk-off behavior
BTC dominance at 56.3% and rising means altcoin positions face systematic headwinds regardless of individual merit
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index movement — if it drops below 25 or rebounds above 35, it changes the thesis significantly
ADA momentum — a 15% weekly gain against a fearful market is unusual; watch if it pulls back to a cleaner entry near support
BONK RSI — at 29 it's near oversold territory; if it dips below 25 while BTC stabilizes, it could be a high-quality bounce trade
market_context: The crypto market is in sustained fear (27/100, worsening trend) with BTC down 2.5% weekly to $63K. A major cold-wallet exploit ($89M) and Trump Media selling BTC are adding selling pressure, while high BTC dominance (56.3%) is crushing altcoin performance.
context_banner: Market fear is persistent and worsening — disciplined patience now preserves capital for higher-conviction setups that will emerge after this selling pressure exhausts.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening weekly trend (27.9 avg) — close to the 25 threshold where validated Rule #3 dictates holding rather than acting.

KAITO RSI at 87 (extreme overbought, strong sell signal) and BONK RSI at 29 (oversold bounce zone) are the two strongest RSI readings, but they point in opposite directions and neither has confirming chart structure.
Coldcard cold-wallet exploit spreading to 4,500 addresses with $89M losses is the largest security incident since FTX, adding bearish sentiment pressure.
Trump Media sold another 2,628 BTC reducing holdings to 4,261 — direct selling pressure on Bitcoin and a negative sentiment signal.
ADA showing +9.7% daily and +15.3% weekly gain with $666M volume is the strongest momentum in the top 20, but no chart analysis data was available to confirm setup quality.
